name: h3-game-sprites
title_zh: 视频生成转逐帧精灵图，动作全对齐绿幕抠像
tagline_zh: 用 MiniMax H3 生成动作视频再切帧，省掉逐帧手绘。角色静止帧打底、待机帧锁形，每招每式都能循环且不跑型。
tagline_en: Generate motion with MiniMax H3 video, cut into keyed sprite frames. Idle-pin keeps moves on-model and.
desc_en: Build 2D game sprite sheets by generating motion with MiniMax H3 (Hailuo) video, then cutting the footage into validated chroma-keyed sprite frames - the Mortal Kombat method with a video model instead of filmed actors. Covers the character-still recipe, the idle-pin trick that keeps every move on-model and loopable, per-move clip briefs, frame extraction with keying and numeric QC, seamless walk-
why_zh: 拿视频模型当动作演员，再用待机帧当锚点锁住角色形变。比直接抽帧多一道数值质检，废帧当场筛掉。
why_en: Video model as stunt actor, idle frame as rig anchor. Adds numeric QC between raw frames and sheet—kills off-model frames, keeps.
limit_zh: 只出绿幕抠好的精灵帧和质检报告，不打包成引擎动画、不处理透明背景合成。需要 MiniMax H3 视频 API 权限。
limit_en: Outputs keyed sprite frames + QC report only—no engine animation, no compositing. Requires MiniMax H3 API access; footage must start from static.
title_en: Turn video clips into validated game sprite sheets
